candidate.hypothesis: Resident predecoded Q4_K (ds,dm) tables with the validated 2-row predec kernel will remove repeated scale-index unpacking from the Qwen14 decode path and clear the TG20 gap without changing source quant bytes.
candidate.mechanism: Set HAWKING_GRAVITY_Q4_SCHEDULE=predec_2r and HAWKING_GRAVITY_Q4_PREDEC=1; build scale tables once at load and use gemm_q4_k_v4_predec_2r for eligible raw Q4_K GEMVs, with strict b9430 fallback for unsupported offset paths.
candidate.fallback: Reject on any Numeric Parity V2.1 or continuation mismatch, CPU fallback, resident-byte admission failure, complete-token wall/p95/p99 regression, or incomplete predecode coverage. Extra scale residency is accounted explicitly.
candidate.reopen_condition: Only a different scale representation, fused graph, or source-compatible kernel may reopen this lane.

control.representation: same artifact, strict b9430 Q4_K schedule

admission.extra_scale_residency_bound: <= 44% of Q4_K payload, measured at open

promotion_boundary: Only same-model complete-token parity plus CLEAN Metal timing can promote; current Qwen14 TG32 floor remains unchanged until then.
